\sphinxAtStartPar
Base class for systematic coverage path planners.

\sphinxAtStartPar
This class provides shared functionality for:
\sphinxhyphen{} Occupancy map preprocessing
\sphinxhyphen{} Contour extraction
\sphinxhyphen{} Coordinate conversion
\sphinxhyphen{} ROS visualization publishing
\sphinxhyphen{} Debug visualization

\sphinxAtStartPar
Child classes should implement their own \sphinxtitleref{generate\_path()}
method to produce coverage trajectories.


\paragraph{Attributes}
\label{\detokenize{mirte_lc_nav2.navigator_types:attributes}}\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{navigator\_type}{[}str{]}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Identifier for the planner category.

\sphinxlineitem{paths}{[}list | None{]}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Generated coverage paths.

\sphinxlineitem{map}{[}np.ndarray | None{]}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Occupancy grid map.

\sphinxlineitem{polymap}{[}list | None{]}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Polygon representation of the map contours.

\sphinxlineitem{threshold}{[}float{]}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Occupancy threshold used to classify obstacles.

\sphinxlineitem{resolution}{[}float{]}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Planner waypoint resolution in meters.

\sphinxlineitem{map\_resolution}{[}float{]}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Resolution of the occupancy map in meters/pixel.

\sphinxlineitem{node}{[}rclpy.node.Node | None{]}
\sphinxAtStartPar
ROS2 node used for logging and publishers.

\end{description}
